outcome: Fetal vein-to-maternal artery mole percent excess ratio for essential amino acids
Microvillous plasma membrane (MVM) system A and system L transport activity
cohort: The study included baboons fed either a control (ad libitum) or maternal nutrient restriction diet (70% of control) from gestational day 30.
finding: Reduced in vivo placental amino acid transport, specifically for tryptophan and overall MVM system A and L activity, was observed in baboons with maternal nutrient restriction before the development of significant fetal growth restriction.
birth_weight: Fetal weights were not significantly different between MNR and control groups at GD 140.
gest_age: Baboons were fed diets from gestational day (GD) 30, and measurements were taken at GD 140.
